name: Model inventory attestation
description: Owners confirm each quarter that their entries in the model inventory are complete and current.

name: Findings panel
description: A fairness review panel reads test results and records whether to change, accept or retire the model.

name: Second pair of eyes
description: Anything the system flags as unusual goes to a named analyst who can reverse it before it takes effect.

name: Incident playbook v1
description: A playbook for model incidents, kept as the incident playbook until the incident process was rewritten. Retired.

name: Outcome gap memo
description: A memo each half year compares approval rates across customer groups and sets out what was done about gaps.

name: Reviewer training
description: Reviewers complete a course on the limits of the system and pass a test before they join the human in the loop rota.

name: Reason code review
description: Compliance checked each month that the reason code sent to customers matched the model's top factors. Retired.

name: Customer complaint log
description: Complaints about customer chat are logged with the customer, date and outcome, and reviewed by a manager each month.

name: Branch opening hours audit
description: Area managers confirm that posted opening hours match the staffing rota.

name: AI disclosure banner
description: Customer-facing screens show an AI disclosure banner before the first answer.

name: Retired system sweep
description: Technology scans for calls to a switched-off system each month and reports any that remain.

name: Payment file checks
description: Treasury operations run a data reconciliation between the payment file and the bank statement every day.

name: Production system patching
description: Technology applies security patches to production systems and reports overdue items each month.

name: Supplier change notice
description: Contracts require notice of any change to a purchased model, and the owner reviews each notice for impact.

name: Lineage map
description: Data engineering keeps data lineage from source system to model input and reviews it twice a year.

name: Instructions for use
description: Each system ships with instructions for use that state purpose, limits and how to reach a person.

name: Deployment freeze rule
description: Production pipelines refuse any build that lacks a signed ticket from the system owner.

name: Branch cash handling
description: Tellers follow cash limits. There is no human review of till counts beyond the daily tally.

name: Weekly read of live answers
description: Reviewers read a weekly sample of live answers and score them against a checklist.

name: Review of declines
description: A trained reviewer checks every automated decline before the customer is told, using the human review queue.

name: Decommission checklist
description: A checklist covers access removal, record archive and notice to dependent teams when a system is shut down.

name: Decline reason wording
description: Plain wording for each decline reason was reviewed twice a year. Retired when the letter process moved.

name: Independent validation
description: The validation team, separate from developers, tests each model before release and issues a written opinion.

name: Outcome gap testing
description: Fair lending analysts run disparity testing on outcomes each half year and report gaps over the set limit.

name: Weekly change board
description: A change board meets weekly and approves or rejects each change request for production AI systems.

name: Release review
description: Each release gets a release review that compares test results with the last validated version.

name: Network traffic watch
description: Security operations watch network traffic for unusual volumes. This is not model monitoring and covers no AI system.

name: Vendor model assessment
description: Third-party risk staff run a vendor model assessment covering testing, data use and support before signature.

name: Monitoring escalation
description: Breaches of model monitoring thresholds are escalated to the owner within five days and tracked to closure.

name: Printer fleet lease review
description: Facilities reviews the printer lease terms before each renewal.

name: Replication exercise
description: Analysts outside the build team rebuild the headline results from raw data and reconcile any difference.

name: Feed reconciliation
description: Operations performs a data reconciliation between source totals and model input totals every month.

name: Switch configuration watch
description: Network engineers use a drift dashboard to see when switch settings move away from the approved build.

name: Server performance report
description: Infrastructure reports server performance and capacity each month to the owner of each system.

name: Change record audit
description: Quarterly sample of change approval records to confirm each has the approver and test evidence attached.

name: Call recording retention
description: Retention of call recordings follows the legal schedule; it is not a change approval step and does not cover releases.

name: Validation findings tracker
description: Each finding is logged with an owner and a due date, and the validation team reports ageing to the risk committee.

name: Drift dashboard
description: A drift dashboard tracks input and output distributions and notifies the model owner when they move beyond thresholds.

name: Travel expense policy check
description: Finance samples travel claims against the expense policy.

name: Notice wording review
description: Compliance reviews each user notice for reading level and accuracy before it is published.

name: Go-live gate
description: A system cannot be released until its entry in the model inventory has an owner and a risk tier.

name: Fire drill
description: Each site runs a fire drill twice a year and files the attendance sheet.

name: Input file checks
description: Automated data quality checks run on each training and scoring file and block files that fail.

name: Supplier invoice approval
description: Procurement approves supplier invoices against signed contracts before payment.

name: Food safety audit
description: An outside firm audits the staff canteen once a year.

name: Data centre badge review
description: Facilities reviews badge access to the data centre every quarter.

name: Spreadsheet inventory check
description: Annual check of the model inventory spreadsheet. Retired when the inventory moved to the platform.

name: Inventory completeness sweep
description: Second-line staff compare the model inventory against purchase orders and cloud accounts to find systems nobody listed.

name: Override log
description: Every override of an automated result is logged with the reviewer and the reason, and the log is sampled each quarter.

name: Live systems register
description: Platform team keeps a list of every deployed AI system with its owner and tier, and checks it against deployments each month.

name: Challenger comparison
description: Validators build a simpler challenger model and compare its results with the production model on the same data.

name: Annual supplier statement
description: Each year suppliers send a vendor attestation that covers testing, security and subcontractors.

name: Input screen
description: Analysts run proxy screening on every input field against protected traits before the field is used.

name: Exception handling
description: There is no exception to human review for declined applications; staff cannot skip the queue.

name: Performance monitoring
description: Monthly performance monitoring compares live results with the levels set at validation and raises an alert on a breach.
